screen.subject: 明日の会議資料（作成中）
screen.line: 予算：研修・講師への謝礼

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 2: 25 words for the people you work with and for meetings.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a section chief and a team member.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Kimura, how are the materials for tomorrow's meeting coming along?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: I'm making them now. I think I can send them this afternoon.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Thanks. Could you add one budget item?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Understood. The budget for last week's training, right?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Yes. Please include the lecturer's fee as well.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Certainly. Also, about the complaint from Minato Trading Co., Ltd. — their person in charge contacted us in writing.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: What did it say?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: It's a complaint about the late delivery. It's hard to judge from my position, so may I ask for your opinion?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: All right. I'll raise it myself at the meeting. In the materials, write out what happened without leaving anything out.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Yes. I'll include a proposal for improvements as well.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: That helps. Did you ask the person in charge at General Affairs to book the meeting room?
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Yes, I've reserved Meeting Room 2. I'll look after the materials too, so tell me any time you want changes.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Thanks. My own boss, Manager Yamaguchi, will look at them too, so please do a careful job.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: One more thing: staff have raised opinions about how our team members are treated, so I'd like to discuss that briefly too.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Understood.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First, words for companies and people.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A company funded by its shareholders; often part of a company's name.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We signed a new contract with Minato Trading Co., Ltd.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The business of buying and selling; often used in company names.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: My father works at a trading company.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A person who works for a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Three new employees joined.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Someone above you at work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I handed the report to my boss.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Someone below you whom you work with.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The section chief listens carefully to their team.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The head of a section in a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Excuse me, do you have a moment? (to the section chief)
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Taking charge of a piece of work as your role.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'll handle this matter.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The person in charge of that work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The person in charge will call you back.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Your place or role among people or in a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Try thinking from the other person's position.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Working conditions such as pay and time off.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This company treats its employees well.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next, words for meetings and documents.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A room for holding meetings.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll use Meeting Room 1 from three o'clock.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Information put together for a meeting or for work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please make ten copies of the meeting materials.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A paper written out in text.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Keep important communication in writing.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Making documents, materials and so on.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I'm preparing the quote now.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Each individual part of a table or document.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We increased the survey to five items.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Adding something more afterwards.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: May I add two more to the order?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Shortening part of something, or leaving it out.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We're short of time, so I'll skip the explanation.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Giving your opinion, for example in a meeting.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Speak up actively in meetings.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Putting an idea or plan forward to someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We proposed a new service to the customer.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Last, words for requests and training.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Asking someone to do something for you.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We asked an outside company to do the translation.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: An amount of money decided in advance for spending.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The budget is short, so we'll revise the plan.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Keeping things or people properly in order.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please manage your passwords carefully.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Sessions for learning what the job needs.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: New employees receive training in April.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: The person who teaches a training session or class.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today's training is led by Mr Yamada.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A complaint from a customer.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We respond to complaints quickly and politely.
lines.name: 田中課長

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 担当, I'll handle that matter.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Please make ten copies of the meeting ___.

lines.en: Question 2. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 資料, the meeting materials.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which is someone above you at work?

lines.en: Question 3. Which is someone above you at work?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 上司. 部下 is someone below you.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: We're short of time, so I'll ___ the explanation.

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 省略, I'll skip the explanation.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: What do you call the person who teaches a training session?

lines.en: Question 5. What do you call the person who teaches a training session?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 講師.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words for the workplace and meetings.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
